build_raw_pdf_model: build a RawPdf model from JSON data containing PDF pages with cells, paths, and font information
create_page_cells: create Page models with lists of Cell objects containing bounding boxes, content, and font data
parse_pdf_font_metrics: parse FontMetrics models with stem values, character widths, and bounding box information
validate_pdf_histograms: validate Histograms models with mean character height, width, and character count per page
extract_page_dimensions: extract PageDimensions models with bounding box coordinates and page width and height values
